system.description:
The mage perceives the flows of raw magical energy and draws Quintessence from a Node, Tass, or resonant place into their own pattern. Rank 1 senses Prime energy; rank 2 channels and stores it. The gathered Quintessence fuels later magick and can push effects beyond ordinary limits.

Dice Pool: Perception + Occult (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Prime 2; mechanics paraphrased.
